title: Will there be a white person on the winning team?
shortTitle: Will there be a white person on the winning team?
description: Will there be a white person on the winning team?
rules: YES if at least one listed member of an overall winning team voluntarily and explicitly self-identifies as white. Never infer race from names, photographs, appearance, nationality or third-party guesses. NO requires sufficient voluntary self-identification evidence for every listed member of every overall winning team; otherwise VOID. Overall winners means any team officially announced as an overall Hack the North 2026 winner; sponsor-only prizes do not count. If the event is cancelled or the available evidence cannot establish YES or NO, resolve VOID. Trading closes before closing ceremonies; do not reopen after the result is known.
resolutionSource: Official overall winners list and members’ voluntary self-identification.
pricingRationale: Neutral starting price; not an evidence-based forecast.

title: Will a Waterloo team win?
rules: YES if every listed member of at least one overall winning team is enrolled at the University of Waterloo at the time of the hackathon. Mixed-university teams do not qualify. Use voluntary enrollment confirmations or public institutional records, not names or appearance. NO requires enough evidence to rule out all-Waterloo membership for every overall winning team; otherwise VOID. Overall winners means any team officially announced as an overall Hack the North 2026 winner; sponsor-only prizes do not count. If the event is cancelled or the available evidence cannot establish YES or NO, resolve VOID. Trading closes before closing ceremonies; do not reopen after the result is known.
